style: position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: 20px;

children.style: position: fixed !important; left: -9999px !important; height: 0; width: 0; &:checked+label::after { opacity: 1; }

display: inline-block; margin: 0 0 0 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-size: 14px; &::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; border-radius: 4px; width: 14px; height: 14px; transform: translateY(-50%); background-color: transparent; transition: all 0.3s; border: 2px solid var(--bg-base); } &::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; top: 50%; left: 3px; border-radius: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%);  background-color: var(--bg-base); transition: all 0.3s; opacity: 0; }
